ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of Expense Line if the expense is approved by HR.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh HR", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Expense__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending ED Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Approved By ED"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Reimbursed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit an Expense Line if the Expense is in one of Pending ED Approval, Approved by ED or Reimbursed states.
